messages:
Casey (Eng): Hey finance folks  got a weird corpcard charge tonight: "GLOBAL PAY V TLL" $278.67. I booked a training room and paid via vendor link, vendor confirmation email says "Redwood Training Room - Small" but bank descriptor is this global-pay thing. Receipt attached but it's a single line total. Need to expense and we bill client for training.
Renee (Finance): Do you have the original vendor confirmation or invoice? Is this vendor on the approved supplier list?
Casey (Eng): I paid via a vendor checkout link sent in email from training-host@example.com. Confirmation PDF uploaded: https://files.redwood/trainings/conf_2207.pdf. Vendor not in preferred list. Manager approved training cost in email (Ju approved).
Ju (People Ops): Confirmed I approved. It was urgent so they used a third-party payments provider. Please attach manager approval screenshot when filing.
ExpenseBot: :warning: Automated alert  descriptor mismatch: virtual-terminal aggregator detected. Policy=invoice_required. Reference: VT-2207-01
Renee (Finance): Ok, for virtual-terminal payments we need: 1) vendor invoice with vendor business name + tax number if client-billable; 2) proof of service (training agenda/attendee list) to support client invoice; 3) manager approval. If vendor uses a payments aggregator, request a supplier invoice showing your company as purchaser and a breakdown.
Casey (Eng): I asked vendor for an invoice and agenda. They sent back a payment processor receipt only: https://files.redwood/trainings/pp_receipt_2207.png - says "GLOBAL PAY V TLL" and transaction id. Vendor said they don't generate invoices unless asked and can email one on company letterhead.
Renee (Finance): Good. Ask them to email a proper invoice with line items and their business tax ID. In the meantime, file in Expensify under Training > External Services and attach the confirmation PDF, processor receipt, and Ju's approval screenshot. Add note: "Vendor to provide invoice for client billing; transaction via aggregator GLOBAL PAY V TLL; finance ticket VT-2207-01." We'll hold client invoicing until we have vendor invoice.
Ju (People Ops): For the attendee list, post here the names of employees who attended so finance can create the client billing attachment.
Casey (Eng): Attendees: Casey, Nora, Ben. Training date 2026-07-20, duration 3h. I uploaded agenda: https://files.redwood/trainings/agenda_2207.pdf
Renee (Finance): Received. Filing checklist for case: - Expensify submit (Training > External Services) - Attach confirmation PDF + processor receipt + agenda + manager approval - Note VT-2207-01 and client code CL-410. Code costs: client-billable portion GL 6520-Client-Training. If vendor refuses to issue invoice within 5 business days, finance will process an exception with Supplier Attestation but client invoicing may be delayed.
Casey (Eng): Submitted to Expensify: https://expensify.com/receipt/RE-243210 status pending. Thanks all :thumbsup:
ExpenseBot: :white_check_mark: VT-2207-01 updated: finance assigned (Renee), status = awaiting_vendor_invoice.
notes: Request vendor invoice with line items and tax ID. Submit Expensify with attachments and mark client code CL-410. Finance will hold client invoice until vendor invoice received.
